images.candle_whisper_night: A single small candle glowing in a quiet dark room at night, gentle smoke curling up, an open window with stars, intimate and calm.
images.carpenter_workshop: An old carpenter's workshop with wooden planks, simple hand tools, wood shavings on the floor and a half-finished wooden chair, warm sunlight, nobody present.
images.temple_courtyard: An ancient stone temple courtyard in Jerusalem style with arches and olive trees, morning light, peaceful, nobody present.
images.mihrab_fruit: A small quiet stone prayer room with an arched niche, a woven basket overflowing with fresh grapes, figs and pomegranates on a simple cloth, soft heavenly light, nobody present.
images.white_hair_lamp: An old wooden walking stick leaning beside an oil lamp on a windowsill at night, moonlight outside, humble and hopeful.
images.angel_light_rays: Soft golden light rays streaming down from above into a quiet stone prayer room, sparkles in the air, no figures, wondrous.
images.cradle_dawn: A simple handmade wooden baby cradle with a soft blanket by a window at dawn, warm light, peaceful, nobody present.
images.morning_evening_sky: A sky split softly between a pink sunrise on one side and a deep blue starry evening on the other, over calm hills.
